newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS - Call options crossed in BAT Industries.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Call options crossed in BAT Industries.

text.p: The UK equity options market was lively on Thursday as traders took positions in a variety of stocks as well the FTSE 100 index, dealers said.
In stock options tobacco-to-insurance group BAT Industries was busy with a crossed trade in which 1,400 July 550 calls were dealt at 30p.

There was also a seller of 1,100 lots at 31p in the same series which may have been to protect a shareholding in the company since if the share price falls, then losses from the shareholding will be offset to some extent by the short calls.
By 1450 GMT, BAT shares had fallen 7-1/2p to 538p.
There were crossed trades in Lloyds TSB the banking group. In one deal 380 June 420 calls were crossed at 110p as well as 380 September 550 calls at 34p in what may have been calendar spreads.
The buyer of the spread would expect the difference in the options prices to increase by June in order to make a profit by that time. The seller expects the difference to decrease.
The shares fell 17p to 514-1/2p and will go ex-dividend by 9.0p net on Monday.
Over in the FTSE 100 index options volatility trades were common.
One trader, expecting market volatility to decrease, sold 1,500 February 4350 calls in FTSE at 12p against buying March FTSE futures at 4338. The options expire tomorrow.
Another large trade was the sale of a call spread against buying futures. The spread consisted of selling 750 June 4300 calls at 168p and buying 750 June 4600 calls at 36p.
By 1450 GMT, spot FTSE was down 8.6 at 4348.8 and March futures had lost four points to 4337.
